osvAllowlist.notes: Informational unmaintained-crate notice in v0.2.0's conservative Cargo metadata inventory; Cargo's Windows target tree does not link chrono into xml-prompt-studio.exe.
POSIX fork() private-cookie nonce reuse only; XML Prompt Studio supports Windows only, never calls fork(), and uses no encrypted HTTP cookies.
Url::origin() stack overflow requires ~10,000 nested blob: URL prefixes; prompt text never passes through Url::origin() and the webview enforces a strict local CSP.
